projecthero.beast_boy.ability.ram.desc: A half-second rhino charge: everything in the 6-block lane takes 10 damage and a big knockback. 10 stamina.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.pounce.des: A tiger leap onto the creature you look at (8 blocks): 8 damage and it bleeds for 3 seconds. 10 stamina.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.gorilla_sm: Gorilla arms slam everything in front of you: 12 damage, knocked down. 12 stamina.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.snake_stri: Lunge as a snake: 5 damage, Poison II and Slowness for 4 seconds. 10 stamina.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.trex_roar_: A T-Rex head roars in a cone: 6 damage, mobs flee for 4 seconds, players' screens shake. 25 stamina, 10 s cooldown.
30 seconds as the hulking Beast (60 form health): R 20-damage swipes, G a leap that slams down, C a roar. It smashes through soft blocks (with mob griefing on) and your Morph Chain stays at 5. No other forms or wheel until it ends. 100 stamina, 3 min cooldown.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.context_mo: The animal for where you are: a very fast cheetah on the ground, a hawk in the air, a dolphin (with a swim burst) in water. Press again to turn back.
Become a fly: a tiny body that slips through 1-block gaps and under doors, mobs ignore you, but you can't attack. Press again to turn back.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.elephant_s: An elephant stomp: 14 damage to everything within 4 blocks, slowed. 20 stamina.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.octopus_gr: Four tentacles pull the nearest creatures (6 blocks) in and hold them for 2 seconds. 20 stamina.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.animal_whe: Hold V: the wheel of animals. Point at one and let go to become it (each has its own R, G and C); let go in the middle to turn back.
projecthero.beast_boy.ability.animal_sen: A wolf's nose for 10 seconds: every creature and player moving nearby leaves glowing green footprints. 10 stamina.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.body: Garfield Logan caught Sakutia, a rare disease, as a boy. It turned him green and let him become any animal there is, extinct and alien ones too (always green). He fights by chaining animals together mid-fight, and when he's cornered something bigger comes out: the Beast.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.getting.body: A rare green ocelot lives in jungles (about one jungle ocelot in six). Feed it cod or salmon, then crouch right next to it: it bites you once, and you get a minute of Sakutia fever (slow, weak and dizzy at first). When the fever breaks you wake up as Beast Boy. Dying during the fever ends it. There's also a Sakutia Serum in jungle temple chests: drink it to become Beast Boy at once. Random serums never give this power, and it replaces whatever Primary power you had.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.forms.body: In human form you keep your own skin with a green tint, and every attack is a quick morph: you flash into an animal for half a second, the hit lands, and you're yourself again. Hold V for the Animal Wheel to stay as an animal; each one has its own R, G and C, its own body size (the mouse and the fly slip through 1-block gaps) and its own way of moving. Hawks, pterodactyls, bats and flies fly (double-tap Space to take off); dolphins, sharks, octopuses and whales swim fast and breathe water. Others can ride the whale (up to 4) and the pterodactyl (1) by right-clicking you. Animals can't use items or open things.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.health.body: Every animal has its own health, shown as a Slab bar over your hearts. Hits come off it, not off your hearts. When it runs out you're knocked back to human, dazed for a second, and you can't be that animal again for 10 seconds. That's what makes the big animals tanky.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.stamina.body: The Meter on your HUD. Big animals drain it fast, small ones barely touch it, and it refills while you're human. At zero you turn back. The quick morphs cost a little each.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.chain.body: Each quick-morph hit with a different animal than the last adds a link (up to 5, +8% damage each). Hit with the same animal twice and the chain resets; stop for 5 seconds and it fades. Mix your R, G, Z and C to keep it going.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.instincts.bo: Night vision is always on, and you hear hostile mobs' footsteps from twice as far away.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.trex: 80 health, a tank. R Bite (18), G Tail Sweep (12, knocks away), C Roar (fear).
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.gorilla: 50 health, a brawler. R Punch (12), G Throw a creature, C Chest-Beat (Strength for you and your squad).
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.rhino: 50 health, a charger. R Charge (16) through soft blocks.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.elephan: 70 health, crowd control. R Trunk Throw, G Stomp (14, slows), C Water Spray (puts out fire).
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.wolf: 30 health, a fast hunter. R Bite (8), G Howl (Speed for your squad).
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.bear: 50 health, a bruiser. R Maul (14), G Stand-Up Roar.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.pteroda: 40 health, flies and carries one player. R Dive Claw (12).
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.hawk: 15 health, a fast flying scout. R Talon (5), G Screech marks a target.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.bat: 10 health, a flying scout. R Echolocation shows every creature nearby through walls.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.octopus: 40 health, swims fast. R Ink blinds, G Tentacle Grab.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.whale: 120 health, carries up to 4 players. R Tail Slam (10).
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.mouse: 5 health, tiny: through 1-block gaps, and mobs ignore you.
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.form.beast: Shift+Z only: 60 health for 30 seconds (see The Beast above).
projecthero.guide.beast_boy.commands.bod: Operators: /projecthero power tune beast_boy stamina <0-100>, cooldowns, ocelot (a green ocelot next to you), form <name>.
